# Is your Dockerfile busting its own build cache?

> Paste a Dockerfile and see whether its instruction order defeats Docker's layer cache, from late dependency installs to a lone apt-get update. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/docker-cache-order-check/)
- [This checker vs. reviewing a Dockerfile by eye](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/docker-cache-order-check/vs-manually-reviewing-a-dockerfile.html)
- [Why Docker build cache gets busted](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/docker-cache-order-check/why-docker-build-cache-gets-busted.html)
